messages:
Jane (CEO): Thanks everyone — quick live Q&A focused on sales pipeline, GTM focus, and partnerships updates. We'll keep answers short. Slides: https://redwood.app/allhands/q2-gtm :rocket:
Mike (Head of Sales): Quick snapshot of where pipeline stands right now. Posting numbers and I'll take Qs.
Raj (CRO): tl;dr — healthy pipeline but conversion drag in mid-market.
Mike (Head of Sales): ``
Pipeline (net new): $12.3M ARR
Top-of-funnel: ~3.1k MQLs this quarter
Top deals: 3x ~$1.2M, 5x ~$300k
Avg sales cycle: 6.5 months
Conversion (SQL->Closed): 8%
Lead mix: PLG 40% | Inbound 30% | Partners 20% | Outbound 10%
``
Ana (GTM Lead): Question — what's driving the conversion drag? mid-market or enterprise?
Raj (CRO): Mostly mid-market. Lots of POC churn and pricing conversations. Enterprise still moving but longer cycles are expected.
Sam (Eng): Are there product blockers we should surface? anything from Dedicated/Private causing stalls?
Mike (Head of Sales): Some deals request region-specific private deploys and custom SSO/KMS timelines. Those extend cycles 4–8 weeks usually.
Terra (Partnerships): On partners: healthy inbound from ISV integrations. We closed 2 marketplace-led pilots last month. Want to be clear — partner-sourced revenue is growing but partner enablement needs to scale.
Katie (Marketing): Can we get timing for marketplace listings so we can push joint content/case studies?
Terra (Partnerships): Timeline: partner portal MVP by end of next month, co-marketing playbook in 6 weeks, marketplace listings rolling in Q3.
Jane (CEO): Follow-up — how many partner-led opportunities are in commit?
Terra (Partnerships): Right now ~8 partner influenced opps totalling ~$1.1M ARR. Two are marked as high-confidence.
Mike (Head of Sales): For the sales team: please prioritize partner-influenced deals for next sprint — Terra will share partner contact playbook.
Ana (GTM Lead): GTM focus for next quarter: 1) close out enterprise pilots, 2) turn PLG users into expansion motions, 3) scale partner co-sell.
Raj (CRO): We're launching a dedicated mid-market playbook this week: objection handling, pricing sweet spots, and a trimmed POC checklist. Expect training invites.
Sam (Eng): Any ETA on faster SSO/KMS templates? engineering can prioritize if it unlocks deals.
Terra (Partnerships): We have a prioritized backlog: SSO templates + KMS docs targeted for next two sprints. Raj, Mike — we'll coordinate the pilot customers for testing.
Mike (Head of Sales): Quick ask — can Product flag a 'compatibility' badge for Dedicated/Private on the model catalog? customers ask about which models are supported in private deployments.
Jane (CEO): Good idea. Ana, add to roadmap items for the console.
Ana (GTM Lead): Will do. Also planning a short webcast next month explaining Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted for procurement teams.
Katie (Marketing): I'll draft the landing page and webinar copy. Need case studies — Mike, can you surface 1–2 pilot customers willing to be on-record?
Mike (Head of Sales): Yes — pinging offline.
Raj (CRO): Realistic ask from leadership: increase partner-influenced pipeline by 2x by EOM and reduce mid-market cycle by ~1 month via playbook and better enablement.
Jane (CEO): OK — leadership commits to extra enablement resources if you can show the plan by Friday.
Terra (Partnerships): We'll share the partner portal roadmap + cost estimate by Thursday.
Ana (GTM Lead): We'll share the mid-market playbook draft + training calendar by Friday.
Sam (Eng): We'll prioritize SSO/KMS templates; ETA 3 weeks.
Katie (Marketing): I'll schedule the webcast for week 3 of next month and start promo assets ASAP.
Mike (Head of Sales): One quick product question for Raj/Jane — are we comfortable trading a little margin for faster conversions on mid-market (intro discount + 12mo commit)?
Jane (CEO): Short answer: yes for select cohorts if it accelerates sustainable ARR. We'll formalize policy with finance.
Raj (CRO): Finance ok with limited promotional window — we'll propose guardrails.
Ana (GTM Lead): Any ask for channels or partners to be reprioritized?
Terra (Partnerships): Focus on ISVs and cloud marketplaces first; integrations that reduce enterprise friction (SSO, KMS, region support).
Sam (Eng): Noted. We'll spike the SSO templates this sprint.
Mike (Head of Sales): Thanks all. If you have specific deal questions, post them here or in the #sales-private channel.
Jane (CEO): That's it from leadership. Appreciate the quick answers. We'll do a short follow-up thread with links: playbook, partner roadmap, enablement calendar. :thumbsup:
